newsitem.title: UK: Chelsea Village in 30 mln stg finance talks.
newsitem.headline: Chelsea Village in 30 mln stg finance talks.

text.p: Chelsea Village Plc, the owner of English soccer club Chelsea, said on Wednesday it was in talks with several parties to secure 30 million stg in financing for the remainder of its redevelopment plans.
The company, hit by the death of vice-chairman and benefactor Matthew Harding last month, said terms of the proposed financing had not yet been agreed.
Harding's death in a helicopter crash cast doubt on Chelsea's ability to fund the revamping of Stamford Bridge, the club's stadium in west London.
The loss also fuelled speculation about the company's direction under chairman Ken Bates, with whom Harding had a series of bitter public rows.
Harding has poured about 20 million stg of his personal fortune into Chelsea and owns an estimated 25 percent stake in the club.
